havering.name: Havering
havering.notes: Havering publishes each zone as a list of the streets whose residents can have its permits, with the zone’s hours, in its Parking Permit Zones Lookup. Each zone is drawn around those streets in OpenStreetMap, so it shows where the zone is rather than its exact edge. Where only part of a street is listed, only the part near the zone’s other streets is drawn. Where single yellow lines in a zone run longer than its bays, that extra time is shown as unknown. Street names are matched to OpenStreetMap; a few listed streets couldn’t be found there and aren’t drawn, and GP6 (Stanley Close) isn’t drawn because the borough has more than one.
